summary: Optimizely offers AI-powered experimentation and personalization for websites and apps. Marketers can run A/B tests, manage features, and deliver personalized content.
description:
Optimizely offers AI-powered experimentation and personalization for websites and apps. Marketers can run A/B tests, manage features, and deliver personalized content.

Everything marketing and digital teams need to create content fast, test and personalize, and prove business impact.

A/B and multivariate testing for web/app changes. AI-driven content personalization. Feature flag management for safe rollouts. Real-time analytics for experiment tracking.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Set Up Account
howToUse.description: Create an Optimizely account and log in to your dashboard. Install the Optimizely snippet or SDK on your website or app.

howToUse.title: Launch Experiments
howToUse.description: Create A/B or multivariate tests using the visual editor. Set goals, define variations, and target specific audience segments.

howToUse.title: Enable Personalization
howToUse.description: Use AI-powered personalization features to deliver tailored content and experiences based on user behavior and attributes.

howToUse.title: Manage Feature Flags
howToUse.description: Implement feature flags to roll out new features gradually and safely. Control access for specific user groups.

howToUse.title: Analyze Results
howToUse.description: Monitor real-time analytics to evaluate experiment performance and make data-driven decisions. Apply winning variations to your site or app.
